# RULE R3: only a neutral / normal-like labelled range (or a sex / age band matching the patient) is a reference
# range. Interpretation categories (Deficiency, Borderline, Kidney failure ...) are never the range.
@@ R3 | M | 40 | ferritin with a deficiency category and a normal range
Ferritin 8 ng/mL Deficiency: <15 Normal: 24-336
=> Ferritin | LOW | 8
@@ R3 | M | 40 | cholesterol categories, Desirable is the range
Cholesterol 255 mg/dL Desirable <200  Borderline 200-239  High >=240
=> Cholesterol | HIGH | 255
@@ R3 | M | 40 | triglyceride categories
Triglycerides 620 mg/dL Normal: <150 Borderline: 150-199 High: 200-499 Very High: >=500
=> Triglycerides | CRITICAL_HIGH | 620
@@ R3 | M | 40 | HbA1c categories
HbA1c 7.8 % Normal <5.7 Prediabetes 5.7-6.4 Diabetes >=6.5
=> HbA1c | HIGH | 7.8
@@ R3 | M | 40 | fasting glucose categories
Fasting Glucose 112 mg/dL Normal: 70-99 Impaired: 100-125 Diabetes: >=126
=> Fasting Glucose | HIGH | 112
@@ R3 | M | 40 | folate categories
Folate 1.8 ng/mL Deficient: <3.0 Normal: >5.4
=> Folate | LOW | 1.8
@@ R3 | M | 40 | creatinine with only severity categories: registry range, with a warning
Creatinine 4.0 mg/dL Mild: 1.3-2.0 Moderate: 2.1-4.0 Severe: >4.0
=> Creatinine | HIGH | 4.0
=> warn
@@ R3 | M | 40 | vitamin D with only deficiency categories
Vitamin D 18 ng/mL Deficient: <10 Insufficient: 10-30
=> Vitamin D | LOW | 18
=> warn
@@ R3 | M | 40 | PSA categories
PSA 8.2 ng/mL Normal: 0-4.0 Borderline: 4.0-10.0 High: >10
=> PSA | HIGH | 8.2
@@ R3 | M | 40 | sex labelled haemoglobin, male patient
Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL Male: 13.5-17.5 Female: 12.0-15.5
=> Hemoglobin | LOW | 12.5
@@ R3 | F | 40 | sex labelled haemoglobin, female patient
Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL Male: 13.5-17.5 Female: 12.0-15.5
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 12.5
@@ R3 | F | 40 | creatinine Males / Females
Creatinine 1.2 mg/dL Males: 0.7-1.3 Females: 0.5-1.1
=> Creatinine | HIGH | 1.2

Hemoglobin 15.0 g/dL Men: 13.5-17.5 Women: 12.0-15.5

@@ R3 | M | 40 | category-only lines after the row, no normal-like label: registry
Creatinine 1.0 mg/dL
Stage 1: <1.2
Stage 2: 1.2-2.0
=> Creatinine | NORMAL | 1.0
=> warn
@@ R3 | M | 40 | wrong-sex-labelled single range is not the patient's
Ferritin 400 ng/mL Female: 11-150
=> Ferritin | HIGH | 400

Hemoglobin 12.2 g/dL Male: 13.5-17.5
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 12.2
